title: Grammarly introduces generative AI tool GrammarlyGO

facts.fact: Grammarly's product offerings boast 30 million daily users globally, according to the article's report of Grammarly's own figures.
facts.quote: which boast 30 million daily users globally

facts.fact: Grammarly announced GrammarlyGO, a generative AI content creation tool slated for beta release in April 2023.
facts.quote: Today, Grammarly announced GrammarlyGO, a generative AI product slated for beta release in April.

facts.fact: Users of Grammarly Free will be able to try GrammarlyGO in select markets, while it will also be available for Grammarly Premium, Business, for Education and for Developers.
facts.quote: Users of Grammarly Free will be able to try the new product in select markets.

facts.fact: According to the article, ChatGPT has grown to upwards of 100 million users since it burst on the scene late 2022.
facts.quote: has grown to upwards of 100 million users since then

facts.fact: GrammarlyGO allows users to compose a draft with a single prompt and generates short email responses with one click.
facts.quote: GrammarlyGO allows users to compose a “high-quality” draft with a single prompt.

facts.fact: GrammarlyGO claims it can adjust the length of text with a single click.
facts.quote: Additionally, it claims to be able to adjust the length of the text with a single click.
